title: Jacket potatoes with broccoli, peas and tahini

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain store-cupboard staple: potatoes, broccoli, tinned chickpeas, peas, tahini, lemon and herbs.

supermarket.reason: Baking potatoes, broccoli, chickpeas, tahini, spring onions and peas in the pod are all everyday Tesco items in June.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a bowl and a whisk, and the technique is simple baking and roasting.

works.reason: Large potatoes baked for an hour at 200°C, broccoli and chickpeas roasted for 20 minutes and peas for 5 minutes are sound timings, and the tahini, lemon and water ratio makes a pourable dressing for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes is enough to pod 500g of peas, cut florets, slice garlic and spring onions, and whisk the dressing, and the 60-minute cook matches the bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used and nothing unlisted appears; the step's '1 tsp paprika' clearly means the smoked paprika in the seasoning list, though it would be tidier to say 'smoked paprika'.

seasonal_feel.reason: Roasted broccoli is the main topping, backed by fresh June peas, mint and spring onions, which makes a light enough jacket for midsummer.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: A filling plate of potato, broccoli, chickpeas and peas with a tahini dressing has protein and plenty of vegetables, and a family would happily eat it.
